dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do I sacrifice cursed monster souls?

dialogues.speaker: Perplexed Treasure Hunter
dialogues.text: Killing a <color=#00E1FFFF>normal monster</color> sacrifices only one cursed soul. Killing a stronger <color=#00E1FFFF>elite monster</color> will sacrifice 4-6 souls. Keep this in mind when trying to reach 100 souls, especially given the time limit.
